purge_embargo.feature_fit_scope: Medians, means, standard deviations, and category levels fit on train only.
purge_embargo.history_update_rule: Completed gap events may update a later horse's history only when source_event_time is strictly earlier than prediction_event_time; every expanding or rolling feature shifts at complete race-event granularity.

racing_mechanism: The two audited roots use the current race's eventual winner and top-three membership as oracle selectors over member prior strength, creating a train/live regime switch. Removing the roots, every contaminated fitted-output descendant, draw/market/result inputs, and all unproved as-of modules leaves only declared-card facts, strictly shifted horse form, and draw-independent declared-field context. Those channels can express pre-race relative ability and running-style fit without knowing the result; the experiment is designed to show openly if that legitimate signal is too weak after the oracle channel is removed.
